controls.title: Update posture
controls.nextStep: Open your operating system's update settings and install any pending security updates.

controls.title: Disk encryption
controls.nextStep: Review disk encryption in your operating system settings and keep recovery material in a safe place.

controls.title: Host firewall
controls.nextStep: Review firewall profiles and enable protection for the networks you use.

controls.title: Screen lock
controls.nextStep: Set a password-protected screen lock that activates after a short period of inactivity.

controls.title: Remote access
controls.nextStep: Review enabled remote-access services. Keep only services you intentionally use and protect them with strong authentication.
